pillars.name: Social
pillars.story: Human development, migration, youth inclusion and adult health

cards.name: Human Development Index (HDI)
cards.subtitle: Very high human development, reflecting health, education and income achievements.

cards.name: Foreign-born population
cards.subtitle: Migration shapes the workforce and society. Share of residents with recorded country of birth.
cards.source: Statistics Division, Census demographic profile, p. 9

cards.name: Youth not in employment, education or training (NEET) (%)
cards.subtitle: Youth inclusion remains important even when overall employment conditions are stronger.

cards.name: Prevalence of arterial hypertension
cards.subtitle: High blood pressure highlights the need for prevention and long-term care. Historical national prevalence, not a current estimate.
cards.source: PAHO, Health in the Americas country profile

pillars.name: Economic
pillars.story: Goods dependence, public financing, tourism earnings and household costs

cards.name: Public debt stock
cards.subtitle: IMF-estimated public debt burden affects financing for services and resilience; differs from earlier government projections.

cards.name: Balance of Trade
cards.subtitle: Imports and Total are the published trade-table column labels. Total comprises domestic exports and re-exports; services are excluded. The balance is a deficit of EC$2,297.73 million.
cards.source: National Bureau of Statistics, updated 8 June 2026

cards.name: Gross tourism receipts
cards.subtitle: Tourism generates substantial external earnings. This ratio is not tourism’s contribution to GDP.

cards.name: Headline Inflation
cards.subtitle: Rising prices affect purchasing power. This is a twelve-month change, not annual-average inflation.
cards.source: National Bureau of Statistics, August 2026 CPI bulletin

pillars.name: Environmental
pillars.story: National electricity supply and marine biodiversity protection

cards.name: Electricity generation
cards.subtitle: Non-renewable generation dominates electricity supply, linking energy transition with resilience.

cards.name: Proportion of important sites for biodiversity that are covered by protected areas
cards.subtitle: Country-level average protected-area coverage of marine Key Biodiversity Areas. Not the percentage of national waters protected.
cards.source: UN ECLAC, Statistical Yearbook 2025; SDG biodiversity coverage

notes: Debt and tourism receipts are IMF 2025 estimates, not the government budget’s earlier projections.
Tourism receipts are not tourism GDP contribution; hospitality sector shares are not total tourism shares.
10 country-level indicator themes: 4 Social, 4 Economic, 2 Environmental. Subpopulation measures (adult health and youth inclusion) cover the country, with age definitions explicit.
Removed parish and island-specific headline measures. Drought denominator could not be established as nationwide.
Migration uses the 2011 national census and only residents with recorded country of birth.
National publications underpin migration, merchandise trade and inflation. International institutions supply the other country-level measures.
No countrywide climate-loss or current desalination percentage is presented without verification.

population.name: Population projection at mid-year estimates
population.source: Statistics Division, Ministry of Finance and Corporate Governance
